checks.headline: Build the business that can think with you.

checks.name: history
checks.visibleText:
You are not the first person to wonder what a new tool might take from you.

We have been asking that question for centuries.

01
370 BC · WRITING
If knowledge lives outside us, will memory grow weaker?

WHAT CHANGED
Ideas could travel beyond one voice and survive their maker. We changed what memory was for.

WHAT CHANGED

checks.name: leadership-dividend
checks.visibleText:
THE RETURNED HOUR

What will you do with the hours it gives back?
Ask the harder question.
Spend more time with people.
Make the consequential call earlier.
A hybrid organisation does not ask you to think less. It helps you act on more of what you know.
